summary: Rare's bear-and-bird platform series; use the Xbox 360/Rare Replay/backward-compatible versions for the N64 games, mGBA for the GBA entries, and Xbox One X/Series compatibility for Nuts & Bolts.

entries.title: Banjo-Kazooie
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox Live Arcade / Rare Replay version

emulation.emulator: Xbox backward compatibility; N64 emulator fallback

primary.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S
primary.version: Xbox Live Arcade / Rare Replay version
primary.why: The Xbox 360 port adds HD presentation and implements Stop 'N' Swop, and it is available through Rare Replay/backward compatibility on modern Xbox.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360/Rare Replay version on Xbox One or Series hardware; use Nintendo Switch Online or N64 emulation only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Fan recompilations are not official series releases and are not used as the primary archive route.

entries.title: Banjo-Tooie
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox Live Arcade / Rare Replay version

emulation.emulator: Xbox backward compatibility; N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use N64 routes only for original-console comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD Xbox version on modern Xbox hardware

primary.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S
primary.version: Xbox Live Arcade / Rare Replay version
primary.why: The Xbox 360 port is the modern HD route and is included through Rare Replay/backward compatibility; it also uses the revived Stop 'N' Swop connection from the Xbox Banjo-Kazooie port.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360/Rare Replay version on Xbox One or Series hardware; use Switch Online/N64 only for original-console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Switch Online release preserves the N64 version rather than the Xbox HD version.

primary.why: Grunty's Revenge is a GBA interquel, while the mobile version removes some presentation/tracking features; mGBA gives the best practical fidelity for the full original handheld game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA version through mGBA with integer scaling, or on original GBA hardware.

primary.why: Missions is a mobile compilation of Grunty's Revenge minigames and has no modern port documented.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as an archival Java/mobile release; no current official modern route is documented.

primary.why: Banjo-Pilot is a GBA-only racing spin-off; mGBA gives the best practical fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA release through mGBA, or on original GBA hardware.

entries.title: Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts
entries.definitive_edition: Rare Replay / backward-compatible release with L.O.G.'s Lost Challenges DLC

emulation.notes: Use Xbox One X/Series hardware for enhanced output.

primary.platform: Xbox One X / Xbox Series X/S
primary.why: Nuts & Bolts is Xbox 360-only, included in Rare Replay, backward-compatible on modern Xbox, and Xbox One X enhanced to run at 4K.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay or Xbox backward compatibility on Xbox One X/Series hardware; include L.O.G.'s Lost Challenges DLC if available.
